title: Comparison of uniformly bounded hypercohomology spectral sequences
statement: Let $I$ be a small directed set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i\in I$ let $(E_{r,i}^{p,q})_{r\geq1}$ be a cohomological spectral sequence of abelian groups [def-sp-spectral-sequence], indexed with $p$ the cohomological degree and $q$ the filtration degree, with $d_1:E_{1,i}^{p,q}\to E_{1,i}^{p,q+1}$. Let $(E_r^{p,q})_{r\geq1}$ be another such spectral sequence. Give the first family transition morphisms of spectral sequences $u_{i'i}:E_{\bullet,i}\to E_{\bullet,i'}$ for $i'\geq i$, satisfying the identity and composition laws, and give compatible morphisms $v_i:E_{\bullet,i}\to E_\bullet$. For every $n$, let $A_i^n$ and $A^n$ be abelian groups with decreasing filtrations $F^qA_i^n$ and $F^qA^n$ [def-sp-filtration]. Give filtered transition homomorphisms $a_{i'i}^n:A_i^n\to A_{i'}^n$ satisfying the identity and composition laws, and filtered homomorphisms $b_i^n:A_i^n\to A^n$ with $b_{i'}^n a_{i'i}^n=b_i^n$. Suppose that $u_{i'i}$ and $v_i$ induce $a_{i'i}^n$ and $b_i^n$ on abutments, and that for every $i,p,q$ the convergence isomorphisms $E_{\infty,i}^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q A_i^{p+q}$ and $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q A^{p+q}$ commute with these morphisms. Assume (i) $\varinjlim_i E_{1,i}^{p,q}\to E_1^{p,q}$ induced by $v_i$ is an isomorphism for every $(p,q)$; (ii) one integer $a$ works for all $i$ and for $E$: their $E_1^{p,q}$ vanish if $p<0$ or $q<a$; (iii) all pages stabilize in each bidegree to the displayed $E_\infty$; and (iv) for every $n$, the filtrations have $F^qA_i^n=A_i^n$ and $F^qA^n=A^n$ for $q\leq a$, and $F^qA_i^n=F^qA^n=0$ for $q>n$, compatibly for all $i$. Then the homomorphism $\varinjlim_i A_i^n\to A^n$ induced by the $b_i^n$ is an isomorphism for every $n$.
